Junior / Intermediate Application Systems Analyst –

Hāpai Kaupapa - CLOSED

Ōtaki Campus

Te Wānanga o Raukawa is seeking a motivated  Junior / Intermediate Application Systems Analyst  to join  Hāpai Kaupapa  in Ōtaki.


This role supports strategic projects across the Wānanga by designing, building and improving digital solutions using  Microsoft Power Platform, SharePoint Online and Microsoft 365 . You will work with project teams to develop apps, automations and dashboards that improve workflows and help kaimahi confidently engage with digital tools.


Māu e mau mai:

A qualification in Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent experience)

Experience with  Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI)

Familiarity with  SharePoint Online and Microsoft 365 tools

Interest in system integration (experience with  Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central  is a bonus)

Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to test, troubleshoot and support digital solutions

Clear communication skills and the ability to support non-technical users


E rapu ana mātou i tētahi tangata e:

Is curious, adaptable and eager to learn new technologies

Enjoys building practical digital solutions and improving systems

Works well independently and as part of a collaborative team

Is committed to working within a kaupapa Māori environment


Ka tukuna e mātou:

A supportive, kaupapa-driven working environment

Opportunities to grow your skills across  Power Platform, Microsoft 365 and emerging AI tools

The chance to contribute to digital innovation that supports our Wānanga community


Join us and help build the digital tools that support our tauira, kaimahi and kaupapa.


Applications close: Monday 30 March 2026


For further information or to apply for this role, please contact:

 

Sam Hata, Te Whare Tiaki Rawa

Īmēra: sam.hata@twor.ac.nz

Waea: 06 3649011
